name: Drawing revision
description: v2 (W5, 2026-09-12): the first procedure authored in the tool rather than by hand. Two steps carrying exactly what the legacy documentation track recorded (LEGACY-SYSTEM.md §8: a status, a note, a date and a document link) — no more, because the owner's words on drawings stop there (FR-3.1: a distinct step; FR-5.2: the drawing system holds the file, the platform holds the depiction by drawing key). Anything richer — depiction rows by drawing key, a check step, reconciliation findings — is put to the owner on a card with this version as the example. Called by SETTINGS_CHANGE at COMPLETION over the same work request. Replaces the W4 placeholder v1 (decision #112).

items.title: [14a] Identify the drawings affected by the change
items.instruction: List every drawing the settings change touches — schematics, wiring, setting sheets, one-lines — by its drawing number as the drawing system knows it. This is the scope the revision is checked against; a drawing left off this list is a drawing nobody revises.

items.title: [14b] Record the revised issue
items.instruction: When the drawing system has issued the revised drawings, record the issue here: the link to the issued set, its revision label, the date it was issued and any note. The platform keeps the depiction reference; the drawing system keeps the file.
